image_description: A group of four people (three women, one man) posing in academic regalia. They are wearing black doctoral gowns with velvet panels and bars on the sleeves, along with mortarboard caps with tassels. The background is a warm, textured studio backdrop. The subjects are smiling and interacting, with one holding a diploma scroll.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flowing full-length garment with rectangular silhouette draping from shoulders to ankles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The gowns clearly exhibit the voluminous, rectangular drape characteristic of academic robes, obscuring the body shape beneath.
The gowns open down the center front, revealing the attire underneath, maintaining general bilateral symmetry in their cut.
The heavy fabric and loose fit successfully hide the specific body contours of the wearers, consistent with the class definition.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Wide open sleeves extending well below hand level.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The distinctive bell-shaped or pointed sleeve extensions (doctoral sleeves) are visible, particularly on the subject to the right, hanging loosely.
The front panels of the gowns are visible, featuring the velvet facings typical of doctoral regalia.
Collars of shirts/blouses and ties are visible at the neck openings, indicating formal wear underneath.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Heavy matte fabric typically black polyester or wool blend.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fabric appears opaque, heavy, and non-reflective (matte), consistent with traditional gown materials.
There are no specular highlights suggesting shiny material; the light absorption is consistent with matte fabric.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Characteristic sleeve drape extending past the wrist.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The sleeve extensions hang significantly lower than the wrists/hands of the subjects.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The background has a slightly smudged, painterly quality common in AI generations or heavy studio retouching, lacking distinct physical texture details.
The fingers gripping the white scroll appear somewhat fused and lack clear anatomical definition, a common AI artifact in hand-object interaction.
The geometry of the mortarboards is slightly inconsistent; some brims appear warped or lack the rigid straight-line perspective expected of cardboard hats.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of regalia (doctoral vs. bachelor/master) and verify class alignment.
To audit the structural integrity of the limbs and hands, which are partially obscured but critical for detecting fusion artifacts.
To check for edge bleeding between the black gowns and the dark background, and to ensure the gowns are continuous objects.
To assess the overall realism, lighting consistency, and detect subtle generative artifacts in faces and fabric.

focus_areas: Hand anatomy and object interaction (diploma scroll)
Gown sleeve geometry and drape physics
Edge definition between black fabric and background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the hands holding the diploma and the tassel positions. AI often struggles with fine finger details and the complex string geometry of tassels. Verify if the 'velvet' panels on the gowns have a distinct texture difference from the main gown fabric, as this is a key feature of doctoral gowns that AI might blend incorrectly.
